responsibility: Implements GCC’s DWARF call frame information engine and the RTL pass that derives unwind/debug frame state from frame-related instructions. It tracks abstract CFI rows across traces in the post-reload RTL stream, interprets and emits DW_CFA directives or raw encodings, supports CFA and saved-register state propagation needed for .debug_frame and .eh_frame, decides when assembler .cfi directives can be used versus manual emission, and provides the pass_dwarf2_frame gate and execution hooks that enable generic DWARF2 frame generation for targets with compiler-generated prologues.
